_doc: Arenas pintadas con Qwen (2026-11-03, pedido del usuario: 'MUY EPICAS'). tools/paint_arenas.py arma el plano y la pintura; tools/build_arenas.gd las escenas. size = celdas de la grilla en la que se marca todo; scale = agranda la arena (size x scale, misma pintura); water = piletas de agua de verdad [x, y, ancho, alto]; auto = umbral de brillo (celdas claras unidas al centro = piso) o null; open/solid = rectangulos [x, y, ancho, alto] que se abren o cierran despues; rocks = rocas que se rompen; cells = donde se para cada uno; field = la cancha; floor/wall = metatiles (colision y tags). brillo = aclara la pintura (las muy oscuras).

sala_costa_p1._modo: Sala POR PIEZAS del Modo Desafío (sección 10 de docs/PROPUESTA_ROGUELIKE.md): el fondo es el marco del bioma (`src`, piso + paredes) pasado a pixel art a la resolución del juego (`pixel` = [ancho, alto, colores]) y los obstáculos son objetos sueltos (data/rogue/salas/<id>.json, RoomPieces); el agua de sus charcos sale de esas piezas. Celdas reales (sin `scale`).
sala_costa_p1.name: La caleta del pescador
sala_costa_p1.prompt: Clean detailed 16-bit pixel art, GBA and Nintendo DS RPG map style, top-down 3/4 view of one large EMPTY room of a tropical sea cove, seen from above, 4:3. The whole RIGHT third of the room is open sea: a natural curving shoreline runs from top to bottom, with white foam where small waves break, then shallow bright turquoise water, then deeper blue water at the right edge. The left two thirds are a wide flat sandy beach. The sand has natural variation: pale dry golden-beige sand inland with gentle dune ripples, a band of darker wet tan sand along the water, and thin wavy tide lines. The beach is completely empty: no rocks, no trees, no boats, no plants, no objects on the sand at all. The other sides are enclosed by a thick wall of tall dark brown wet rock cliffs covered in dark seaweed and dark jungle plants. A straight sand path comes in through a gap in the cliffs at the very bottom center edge and leaves through a gap in the cliffs at the very top center edge. The sand is clearly lighter than the dark cliffs. Crisp pixels, limited palette, no blur. No characters, no creatures, no text.
